news.title: As the chorus of Fed hikes grows louder, stocks and bonds decline – US Market Wrap
news.description: Wall Street doubled down on wagers that the Federal Reserve will need to raise interest rates more aggressively, with stocks and bonds dropping as officials issued fresh warnings about inflation. A surprise robust consumer price index reinforced speculation that a quarter-point hike in December is a done deal, with money markets predicting an even higher move.
